regional.title: Regional
regional.description: Default language, time zone and date/time formats for every user. Users can choose their own values under Preferences. Data is still stored in UTC.

hint.timezone: IANA zone name, e.g. Asia/Jakarta (WIB), Asia/Makassar (WITA), Asia/Jayapura (WIT).

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Choose the language, time zone and date/time formats for your account. "Follow system" uses the Admin's settings.
